articles.summary: During the event, Chief Executive Officer Steve Griggs, President Josh Parnes, Chief Financial Officer Jason Clemens, and other members of AdaptHealth’s senior leadership team will provide in-depth reviews of the Company’s business model and competitive differentiation, review its progress in establishing a scalable foundation for profitable growth and shareholder value going forward, and introduce long-term financial goals.
articles.title: Adapthealth Capital Markets Day to Highlight Progress Executing Strategy to Transform Healthcare by Keeping Patients Healthy at Home
